items.title: After working with Congressional reps, the Creators Caucus heads to the Senate
items.summary: What can creators accomplish when they lobby the U.S. Senate? We're about to find out. A bipartisan pair of Senators -- New Jersey Democrat Cory Booker and Louisiana Republican John Kennedy -- have announced the Senate Creators Caucus. The brand-new entity will be a vehicle for "recognizing creators as small business owners, job engines, and culture drivers," according to a YouTube blog post. Sens. Booker and Kennedy kicked off the Caucus with a panel at the Dirksen Senate Office Building in D.C
